files..github/workflows/ci.yml:
name: CI
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      greeting:
        description: what to say
        type: string
        default: hello
  repository_dispatch:
    types: [wf-fixture-ping]
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: say
        run: echo greeting
